item.text: The scaffold has no post storage or list yet, so I’m adding a small posts data layer with a tagged cached read, a Server Action that creates a post, and a form/list on the page. The action will call `updateTag('posts')`, which expires the tagged entry immediately so the next read fetches fresh data.

item.text:
Added a Server Action in [app/actions.ts](/workspace/app/actions.ts:6) that creates a post and calls `updateTag('posts')` after insertion. That immediately expires the tagged cache, so the next read waits for fresh posts.

The page now has a create form and a posts list. The list is cached with the `posts` tag in [app/posts.ts](/workspace/app/posts.ts:14). Since the scaffold has no database, this example stores posts in memory; connect `insertPost` to your database for persistent storage. I didn’t run tests.
